title: LED Efficiency and Laser Threshold Explorer
description: A two-mode simulation of a GaAs light source. LED mode plots internal quantum efficiency against current density from the ABC recombination model, showing the efficiency droop, and the light output against current. Laser mode plots modal gain against carrier density with the cavity loss line, marks the threshold, and draws the light-current curve with its threshold kink. Sliders set the drive current, mirror reflectivity, cavity length, and the SRH, radiative, and Auger coefficients; a checkbox compares a single quantum well with a bulk active layer.

educational.topic: LED efficiency droop and the laser threshold condition
learningObjectives: Explain the efficiency droop of an LED with the ABC model
Calculate the threshold current density of a laser from the gain-loss threshold condition
Compare the light-current curves of an LED and a laser
Choose a suitable light source for a given application
prerequisites: The LED efficiency chain, optical gain, and the threshold condition

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Mode switch with parameter sliders, two linked real-time plots per mode, and a worked readout at the drive current
pedagogical.instructionalStrategy: Predict-test-observe for the droop, followed by a hand calculation of the laser threshold checked against the readout
assessmentOpportunities: Predict how the IQE peak moves when A or C changes
Compute mirror loss, threshold gain, threshold carrier density, and threshold current density by hand
Explain the trade-off between threshold current and slope efficiency as the mirror reflectivity rises

equations: IQE = B n^2 / (A n + B n^2 + C n^3); J = q d (A n + B n^2 + C n^3) / eta_inj
EQE = eta_inj IQE LEE; P_out = EQE (h nu / q) I
Gamma g_th = alpha_i + alpha_m; alpha_m = (1/L) ln(1/R)
J_th = q d (A n_th + B n_th^2 + C n_th^3) / eta_i
P_out = eta_d (h nu / q)(I - I_th); eta_d = eta_i alpha_m / (alpha_i + alpha_m)
assumptions: GaAs, photon energy 1.42 eV; eta_inj = eta_i = 0.95; LEE = 1/(4 n^2) = 2.0 % for a flat surface; alpha_i = 10 cm^-1
Bulk layer: d = 0.1 um, Gamma = 0.3, g = 3e-16 (n - 1e18) cm^-1
Quantum well: d = 8 nm, Gamma = 0.03, g = 2400 ln(n / 2.6e18) cm^-1 (representative values)
LED area 100 um x 100 um; laser stripe 5 um wide
limitations: No heating, no thermal rollover, no spontaneous emission from the laser below threshold
VCSEL cavities are outside the range of the model and are not plotted
Wall-plug efficiency is not computed because the diode voltage is not modeled
